slides.title: Smart India Hackathon — 2026
slides.domain: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning / Smart Governance
slides.problem_statement: AI/ML-Powered Early Detection of Anomalies, Fund Leakages, and Collusion Rings in MPLADS (SIH26102 / PS-36502)
slides.institution: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering, Kalavakkam (SSNCE) / MoSPI
slides.prototype_proof: SETU Pre-Disbursal Capital Preservation & Cartel Interception Platform (Benchmarked on 5,000+ works in 589 authentic Indian districts with <200ms inference)

points_left.title: Stopping Leakage at the Gate :
points_left.body: Instead of waiting 2 years for CAG post-mortem audits, SETU intercepts fund leakage right at the pre-sanction stage in under 200 milliseconds, checking proposal costs, bids, and GPS locations before the District Magistrate signs treasury releases.

points_left.title: 8-Model Orthogonal Forensic AI Triangulation :
points_left.body: Deconstructs raw project proposals across 7 specialized domain anomaly checks (cost outliers, spatial density, single-bid cartels, contractor overload, milestone velocity, and entity network graphs) fused with a Calibrated Supervised XGBoost Classifier to eliminate false alarms.

points_right.title: Uncovering Covert ₹5L Tender Splitting :
points_right.body: Automatically catches corrupt practices where large civil projects are deliberately sliced into multiple smaller works just below the statutory ₹5 Lakh e-tender ceiling (e.g., ₹4,92,000) to bypass mandatory competitive bidding under MoSPI Rule 14.2.

points_right.title: Evidence-Based Prioritization & Legal Reason Traces :
points_right.body: Assigns every proposal an instant clearance tier (Automatic Clearance, Conditional Approval, Mandatory Technical Audit, or Reject) with plain-language Tree SHAP legal explanations citing General Financial Rules (GFR 155), eliminating guesswork for sanctioning officers.

slides.title: Technical Approach

layer_1.name: Layer 1: External Telemetry & Data Sources
items: e-SAKSHI Portal (work proposals, estimated costs & sanctions)
PFMS & Treasury (milestone disbursements & payment timing)
Contractor Registry (tender bids, tax IDs & execution capacity)
Geotagged Media (GPS bounds & site inspection photographs)
Calamity Gazettes (NDMA/SDMA emergency declarations under §5.3)

layer_2.name: Layer 2: Frontend & GIS Tier
items: Next.js 14 Web UI (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide)
Pre-Sanction Gate (/proposals) scoring files in <200 ms
National Macro GIS (543 constituency choropleth risk maps)
Cartel Graph View (force-directed bipartite collusion explorer)
Executive Anomaly Radar (multi-model dimensional risk vectors)

layer_3.name: Layer 3: Backend & API Services
items: FastAPI Async Engine (sub-200ms REST microservices)
Sentinel Layer 0 (sovereign geofence & landmark sanity gates)
Schema Normalizer (district median baseline standardization)
Celery + Redis Jobs (asynchronous queue & audit logging)
Rule 14.2 Interceptor (catches ₹4.5L–₹5.0L tender smurfing)

layer_4.name: Layer 4: Data & AI/ML Layer
items: PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB (5,000+ authentic works in 589 districts)
7 Domain Engines (Financial, Spatial, Tender, Vendor, Payment, Progress, Graph)
Supervised XGBoost (calibrated fraud probability with conformal bounds)
Grouped Tree SHAP (plain-language attributions grounded in GFR 155)
Risk Fusion v2.0 (outputs: 0-100 Fused Score, Risk Tier & Dossier)

cards.title: Unified Multi-Source Scheme Intelligence
cards.body: Automatically ingests and unifies e-SAKSHI proposals, PFMS treasury disbursements, CPWD schedule of rates, contractor registries, and geotagged field inspection telemetry into a single, structured sovereign intelligence layer.

cards.title: 8-Model Orthogonal Forensic Triangulation
cards.body: Employs 7 independent statistical, spatial, and graph engines alongside a calibrated supervised XGBoost classifier, preventing any single noisy indicator from triggering false positives while ensuring strict domain defense.

cards.title: Sub-200ms Pre-Sanction Interception
cards.body: Radically shifts vigilance from retrospective 2-year CAG post-mortems to real-time pre-sanction gatekeeping (<200 ms), protecting public capital right when the District Magistrate is signing administrative approvals.

cards.title: Statutory Tree SHAP Reason Traces
cards.body: Generates legally defensible, plain-language audit explanations grounded in MoSPI Rule 14.2 and GFR 155, eliminating black-box opacity and giving field vigilance officers transparent parameter drivers for every score.

cards.title: Closed-Loop Bipartite Cartel Detection
cards.body: Uncovers hidden vendor-agency collusion rings, shared registered premises, and revolving-door bidding rings through automated bipartite NetworkX graph analytics with continuous post-sanction execution tracking.

top_cards.title: Feasibility
bullets: Proven Enterprise Technologies: Uses FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, XGBoost, and Next.js 14 for scalable forensic telemetry.
Sub-200ms CPU Inference: Validated inference latency on standard commodity cloud instances with zero costly GPU dependencies.
Modular Architecture: Cleanly decouples ingestion, sentinel boundary gates, anomaly scoring, SHAP synthesis, and UI delivery.

top_cards.title: Viability
bullets: Drop-in e-SAKSHI Compatibility: Directly integrates with MoSPI's API without disrupting existing district administration workflows.
100% Open-Source Stack: Built entirely on open components with ₹0 recurring proprietary licensing overhead or vendor lock-in.
Empirically Verified: Benchmarked on 5,000+ real-world works across 589 authentic Indian districts with 91 passing automated tests.

top_cards.title: Practical Implementation
bullets: Live Operational Prototype: Working platform active with live proposal screening sandbox (/proposals) and interactive national GIS mapping.
Asynchronous Scalability: Redis and Celery task queues easily handle nationwide surges during fiscal year-end sanction deadlines.
Multi-Tier Sovereign RBAC: Built-in governance roles for Ministry, State Nodal, District Collector, and MP allow phased state rollout.

challenges_and_strategies.challenge: Legacy Data Sparsity & Misspellings: Incomplete contractor tax IDs, varied local spelling of agencies, and missing GPS coordinates in historical records.
challenges_and_strategies.strategy: District Median Baselines & CSC Whitelist: Normalizes costs against local geographic medians and whitelists shared public utility infrastructure (Jan Seva Kendras).

challenges_and_strategies.challenge: Disaster & Emergency False Alarms: Legitimate single-bid tenders during emergency flood or cyclone relief mistakenly flagged as procurement fraud.
challenges_and_strategies.strategy: Statutory Calamity Gazette Exemption: Automatically ingests NDMA/SDMA disaster declarations to grant legal waivers under MPLADS Guidelines §5.3.

challenges_and_strategies.challenge: Auditor Distrust of Black-Box AI: Field vigilance officers rejecting automated ML verdicts due to fear of opaque, unexplainable algorithmic decisions.
challenges_and_strategies.strategy: Grounded Tree SHAP & Human-in-the-Loop Override: Delivers transparent reason traces and empowers DMs with recorded statutory overrides for full legal accountability.

stakeholders.impact: Immediate pre-sanction triage prevents inadvertent approval of corrupt, duplicate, or split tenders before treasury cash is released.
Real-time macro-surveillance across all 543 Lok Sabha & Rajya Sabha constituencies via national choropleth dashboards.
Automated inter-district risk comparison, statutory quota compliance (SC 15% / ST 7.5%), and execution bottleneck alerts.
Eradicates single-vendor cartels and monopoly collusion rings, fostering fair, open, and competitive procurement opportunities.
Eliminates ghost infrastructure and project stalls, ensuring vital community assets (drinking water, roads, schools) actually materialize.

slides.title: Reference and Inspiration
references: [1] Lundberg, S. M., et al., 'From Local Explanations to Global Understanding with Explainable AI for Trees,' Nature Machine Intelligence. Tree SHAP Reference for local feature attribution, non-linear fraud scoring, and legally defensible statutory reason traces.

[2] Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), 'MPLADS Scheme Implementation Guidelines (2023 & Revisions),' Government of India. Statutory Policy Reference for Rule 14.2 mandatory e-tendering over ₹5.00 Lakhs, prohibition of artificial work-splitting, and District Authority pre-sanction diligence.

[3] Akoglu, L., Chandy, R., & Faloutsos, C., 'Graph-based Anomaly Detection and Fraud Detection: Problems, Algorithms, and Resources,' ACM KDD. Graph Analytics Reference for bipartite entity network modeling, repeat agency-contractor collusion rings, and PageRank centrality scoring.

[4] Central Vigilance Commission (CVC), 'Directives on Public Procurement, Integrity Pacts, and Tender Vigilance,' Government of India. Public Procurement Integrity Reference for single-bid tender anomaly patterns, anti-cartel vigilance, and transparent rate benchmarking.

[5] Nigrini, M. J., 'Benford's Law: Applications for Forensic Accounting, Auditing, and Fraud Detection,' John Wiley & Sons. Forensic Accounting Reference for first-digit frequency distribution analysis to detect manipulated contractor bills and milestone invoices.

[6] SETU Prototype Codebase, 'SETU: Real-Time Anomaly Detection & Risk Fusion Engine for MPLADS,' GitHub Repository (https://github.com/Barath-j593/sih-2026). Open Source Working Prototype Reference for full-stack implementation, 8-model architecture, and 91 passing test suites.
